articles.title: Tentara Selatan mengumumkan penyebaran dari Bab al- Mandab untuk pertahanan bolster Aden
articles.description: ADEN - Yemen Selatan Angkatan Bersenjata mengumumkan pada hari Minggu penyebaran pasukan mereka dari distrik dan daerah Bab Al- Mandab, barat pemerintah Taiz, sebagai bagian dari upaya untuk memperkuat posisi militer dan memprioritaskan keamanan pemerintah Aden dan tetangga. Dalam pernyataan yang dikeluarkan pada hari Minggu, pasukan mengatakan gerakan berikut perkembangan baru-baru ini di medan perang, termasuk militer buildups dan ancaman menargetkan Aden dan daerah sekitarnya, serta laporan kelompok bersenjata musuh bergerak melalui daerah mengawasi kota. Perbaikan tujuan untuk mengatur posisi militer, memperkuat depan kunci dan memperkuat kehadiran pasukan di daerah dan sepanjang rute yang diperlukan oleh keadaan saat ini. Angkatan Bersenjata Selatan menekankan bahwa mengamankan Aden dan pemerintah tetangga tetap menjadi prioritas, bersama menghadapi ancaman yang sudah ada dan melanjutkan operasi militer melawan milisi Houthi. Mereka menegaskan kembali bahwa konfrontasi mereka dengan Houthis akan terus berlanjut sampai pemberontakan Houthi berakhir, institusi negara dipulihkan, dan keamanan dan stabilitas tercapai. Pasukan-pasukan juga menekankan komitmen mereka untuk menjaga keamanan dan stabilitas di Aden dan menghilangkan ancaman Houthi ke kota, dengan dukungan dan bantuan dari Koalisi untuk mendukung Legitimasi di Yaman, yang dipimpin oleh Arab Saudi. Pernyataan lebih menekankan bahwa tugas nasional dan berbagi tanggung jawab dalam menghadapi ancaman tidak terbatas pada lokasi geografis tertentu, tetapi ditentukan oleh persyaratan operasional dan kepentingan publik. Tentara Selatan memuji upaya dan pengorbanan personil mereka di berbagai medan perang, menggambarkan mereka sebagai sumber kebanggaan dan apresiasi. Mereka memperbaharui komitmen mereka untuk melindungi keamanan dan stabilitas rakyat mereka, menekankan bahwa perubahan keadaan dan perkembangan di tanah tidak akan menghalangi mereka dari memenuhi tugas nasional mereka dan tanggung jawab.
articles.originalTitle: Southern Armed Forces announce redeployment from Bab al-Mandab to bolster Aden’s defenses
articles.originalDescription: ADEN — Yemen’s Southern Armed Forces announced on Sunday the redeployment of their forces from districts and the Bab Al-Mandab area, west of Taiz Governorate, as part of efforts to strengthen military positions and prioritize the security of Aden and neighboring governorates. In a statement issued on Sunday, the forces said the move follows recent developments on the battlefronts, including military buildups and threats targeting Aden and its surrounding area, as well as reports of hostile armed groups moving through areas overlooking the city. The redeployment aims to reorganize military positions, reinforce key fronts and strengthen the forces’ presence in areas and along routes required by the current circumstances. The Southern Armed Forces stressed that securing Aden and neighboring governorates remains a priority, alongside confronting existing threats and continuing military operations against the Houthi militia. They reaffirmed that their confrontation with the Houthis would continue until the Houthi rebellion ends, state institutions are restored, and security and stability are achieved. The forces also emphasized their commitment to maintaining security and stability in Aden and eliminating Houthi threats to the city, with the support and assistance of the Coalition to Support Legitimacy in Yemen, led by Saudi Arabia. The statement further stressed that national duty and shared responsibility in confronting threats are not confined to any particular geographical location, but are determined by operational requirements and the public interest. The Southern Armed Forces praised the efforts and sacrifices of their personnel across various battlefronts, describing them as a source of pride and appreciation. They renewed their commitment to protecting their people’s security and stability, emphasizing that changing circumstances and developments on the ground would not deter them from fulfilling their national duties and responsibilities.

articles.originalTitle: Saudi Arabia condemns Iranian aerial attacks on Bahrain, calls for immediate halt
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — Saudi Arabia has strongly condemned the Iranian aerial attacks on Bahrain, following a claim by Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) that it had launched six drones targeting a US radar system in the Kingdom. In a statement issued by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs on Sunday, Saudi Arabia reaffirmed its full solidarity with Bahrain in all measures taken to safeguard its security and stability. It also stressed that the Iranian attacks constitute a violation of international law and the principles of good neighborliness. The Kingdom emphasized the importance of immediately halting of blatant Iranian attacks on countries in the region. The statement concluded with Saudi Arabia calling for serious steps toward achieving security and stability for the countries and peoples of the region.

articles.description: 'Melihat pergi tidak pernah pilihan bagi saya': Bagaimana hubungan cinta Hollywood dengan Israel berubah menjadi asam Diganti oleh Fleur Hargreaves pada Mon, 11 / 02 / 2026 - 10: 59 Sejumlah aktor dan pekerja film menantang keterlibatan industri mereka di Israel untuk mengakhiri hubungan beracun antara aktris AS Hannah Einbinder mengenakan pin 'Artists4Creasefire' saat dia menghadiri penghargaan Golden Globe ke-83 di hotel Beverly Hilton di Beverly Hills, California, pada 11 Januari 2026 (Frederic J Brown / AFP) setelah Israel dapat mengandalkan Hollywood untuk memiliki reputasi yang dicurangi, menampilkan peran yang ramah dan kepentingan Barat. Namun, jumlah aktor dan tokoh terkemuka dalam film dan TV yang sedang menghadapi keterlibatan industri dengan pendudukan Israel dan tindakannya di Gaza, yang telah disebut genosida oleh para ahli dan kelompok HAM. Semakin banyak seniman menggunakan platform mereka untuk berbicara tentang nasib warga Palestina dan telah berkontribusi terhadap persetujuan Israel antara penonton Barat. Pada tahun 2025, organisasi berbasis AS Pekerja Film Palestina (FWP), didirikan oleh sekelompok pembuat film tahun lalu, merilis janji untuk mengakhiri keterlibatan dengan genosida di Gaza. Ini mengumpulkan tanda tangan lebih dari 5,500 orang dalam industri, termasuk A-list aktor seperti Josh O 'Connor, Olivia Colman, Andrew Garfield, Emma Stone dan banyak lagi. Terinspirasi oleh pembuat film Bersatu melawan Apartheid, sekelompok seniman yang menolak untuk layar karya mereka di apartheid Afrika Selatan, pertanda berjanji tidak untuk layar film, muncul atau bekerja bersama lembaga film Israel yang terlibat dalam genosida dan apartheid. "Orang-orang siap secara publik menempatkan nama mereka untuk komitmen penolakan... untuk tidak terlibat dalam genosida Israel, seorang juru bicara FWP mengatakan kepada Mata Timur Tengah, menambahkan bahwa ada" kekuatan dalam jumlah ". articles.originalTitle: ‘Looking away was never a choice for me’: How Hollywood’s love affair with Israel turned sour
articles.originalDescription: ‘Looking away was never a choice for me’: How Hollywood’s love affair with Israel turned sour Submitted by Fleur Hargreaves on Mon, 11/02/2026 - 10:59 A growing number of actors and film workers have been challenging their industry’s ‘deep complicity’ with Israel to end the toxic relationship US actress Hannah Einbinder wears an 'Artists4Ceasefire' pin as she attends the 83rd annual Golden Globe Awards at the Beverly Hilton hotel in Beverly Hills, California, on 11 January 2026 (Frederic J Brown/AFP) Off Once Israel could rely on Hollywood to have its reputation laundered, performing the role of a benign ally which shared the values and interests of the West. However, a growing number of actors and prominent figures in film and TV are confronting the industry’s ongoing complicity with Israel's occupation and its actions in Gaza, which a consensus of experts and human rights groups have called a genocide . More and more artists are using their platforms to speak about the plight of the Palestinians and have contributed to Israel’s cratering approval among western audiences. In 2025, US -based organisation Film Workers for Palestine (FWP) , established by a group of filmmakers the previous year, released a pledge to end complicity with the genocide in Gaza. It garnered the signatures of more than 5,500 people in the industry, including A-list actors like Josh O’Connor, Olivia Colman, Andrew Garfield, Emma Stone and many more. Inspired by Filmmakers United Against Apartheid, a group of artists who refused to screen their work in apartheid South Africa, signatories pledged not to screen films, appear at or work alongside Israeli film institutions implicated in genocide and apartheid. “People were ready to publicly put their name to a commitment of refusal... to not be complicit in Israel’s genocide,” an FWP spokesperson told Middle East Eye, adding that there is “power in numbers”. articles.title: Trump mungkin tidak akan menyerang Iran selama tidak memprovokasi AS, laporan mengatakan
articles.description: Trump mungkin tidak menyerang Iran selama tidak memprovokasi AS, laporan mengatakan Presiden Donald Trump telah memberi tahu penasihat senior dalam beberapa hari ini bahwa ia mungkin menunda serangan Iran jika Amerika tidak menghadapi provokasi baru dari Teheran atau Iran- didukung Houthis di Yaman, menurut tiga orang akrab dengan masalah ini. Trump telah beralih antara ancaman meningkatkan perang dengan serangan baru dan mengurangi permusuhan, dan saat ini dan mantan pejabat mengatakan ia tidak muncul telah membuat pikirannya tentang bagaimana menyelesaikan konflik yang tidak populer, yang ia luncurkan pada Februari dengan Israel. Tapi dalam pertemuan dengan penasihat keamanan nasionalnya dan setelah serangkaian briefing intelijen, Trump mengatakan dia mempertimbangkan menunda pemogokan, kata orang-orang, yang, seperti orang lain diwawancarai untuk cerita ini, berbicara dengan kondisi anonimitas. Dia juga menunjukkan simpati untuk sekutu di wilayah tersebut yang telah memintanya untuk tidak kembali ke perang penuh. "Saya bisa mengakhirinya segera, tapi atas permintaan bangsa-bangsa yang ingin saya lindungi, kami melakukannya sedikit lebih lama, sedikit lebih sopan", kata Trump penyiar olahraga Stephen A. Smith pada hari Kamis. Komentar-komentar pribadi Trump membangun pada komentar-komentar publik... memainkan kemungkinan terjadinya perang besar. CALLS DENGAN SAUDI ARAB DAN TURKEY Dalam panggilan telepon selama dua minggu terakhir, Trump meminta pendapat dari Pangeran Saudi Crown Mohammed bin Salman dan Presiden Turki Tayyip Erdogan, yang mendorong dia untuk tidak melanjutkan serangan terhadap Iran, menurut pejabat AS senior dan orang lain akrab dengan masalah ini. Mereka bilang Trump juga tidak membuat komitmen. Trump bilang pada Bin Salman tanggal 31 Oktober bahwa dia berencana menyerang setelah pemilu, tapi putra mahkota memohon agar dia menunda, menyatakan bahwa sanksi ekonomi melawan Iran bekerja, menurut dua orang lagi yang akrab dengan diskusi ini. articles.originalTitle: Trump may not attack Iran as long as it doesn't provoke US, report says
articles.originalDescription: Trump may not attack Iran as long as it doesn't provoke US, report says President Donald Trump has told senior advisers in recent days that he may hold off on attacking Iran if the US faces no new provocations from Tehran or the Iran-backed Houthis in Yemen, according to three people familiar with the matter. Trump has alternated between threats of escalating the war with new strikes and winding down hostilities, and current and former officials say he does not appear to have made up his mind about how to resolve the unpopular conflict, which he launched in February with Israel. But in meetings with his national security advisers and after a series of intelligence briefings, Trump said he was considering holding off on strikes, said the people, who, like others interviewed for this story, spoke on condition of anonymity. He has also indicated sympathy for allies in the region who have asked him not to return to a full-fledged war. "I could end it immediately, but at the request of the nations that I am looking to protect, we are doing it a little bit longer way, a bit more civilly," Trump told sports broadcaster Stephen A. Smith on Thursday. Trump's private comments build on public remarks playing down the likelihood of major warfare resuming. CALLS WITH SAUDI ARABIA AND TURKEY In phone calls over the past two weeks, Trump asked for opinions from Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman and Turkish President Tayyip Erdogan, who both urged him not to resume attacks on Iran, according to a senior US official and another person familiar with the matter. They said Trump made no commitment either way. Trump told bin Salman on 31 October that he was planning to attack after the elections, but the crown prince pleaded for him to hold off, arguing that economic sanctions against Iran were working, according to two more people familiar with the discussion. Saudi Arabia's Foreign Ministry did not respond to a request for comment. Trump has spoken with Erdogan three times since

articles.title: Komandan Hamas Samir Abu Younis tewas dalam serangan Israel terhadap Khan Younis
articles.description: Komandan Hamas Samir Abu Younis tewas dalam serangan Israel terhadap Khan Younis Hamas 'sayap bersenjata mengatakan pada hari Minggu bahwa seorang komandan senior yang membantu merencanakan dan mengawasi 7 Oktober 2023 serangan terhadap Israel telah tewas dalam serangan udara Israel. Brigade Al- Qassam mengidentifikasi komandan sebagai Samir Abu Younis, 53, komandan brigade Rafah nya, dan mengatakan ia dibunuh pada hari Sabtu. Militer Israel mengatakan pada hari Minggu itu telah memukul seorang komandan senior di Hamas apos; sayap bersenjata tetapi tidak mengidentifikasi dirinya. Dokter mengatakan Abu Younis tewas dan lainnya terluka dalam serangan udara yang ditargetkan dia di jalan di daerah Mawasi Khan Younis di Jalur Gaza selatan. Hamas mengatakan Abu Younis bergabung dengan sayap bersenjata Hamas pada tahun 1991 dan telah mengadakan beberapa peran operasional senior di Rafah sebelum menjadi komandan brigade. Hamas mengatakan pemakamannya akan diadakan pada Minggu sore di Khan Younis. Sebuah gencatan senjata Oktober 2025 dihentikan pertempuran besar tetapi belum berhenti serangan Israel atau dijamin pemusnahan Hamas'. Pihak berwenang kesehatan Gaza mengatakan setidaknya 1.600 warga Palestina telah terbunuh sejak gencatan senjata terjadi. Lima tentara Israel telah terbunuh selama periode yang sama. Pihak berwenang Palestina mengatakan lebih dari 74.000 orang telah tewas dalam kampanye militer Israel melawan Gaza, diluncurkan setelah pejuang Hamas- dipimpin membunuh sekitar 1.200 orang di Israel selatan pada Oktober 2023. Laporan oleh AFP
articles.originalTitle: Hamas commander Samir Abu Younis killed in Israeli strike on Khan Younis
articles.originalDescription: Hamas commander Samir Abu Younis killed in Israeli strike on Khan Younis Hamas' armed wing said on Sunday that a senior commander who helped plan and oversee the 7 October 2023 attack on Israel had been killed in an Israeli airstrike. The Al-Qassam Brigades identified the commander as Samir Abu Younis, 53, the commander of its Rafah brigade, and said he was killed on Saturday. The Israeli military said on Sunday it had struck a senior commander in Hamas' armed wing but did not identify him. Medics said Abu Younis was killed and others were wounded in an airstrike that targeted him in a street in the Mawasi area of Khan Younis in the southern Gaza Strip. Hamas said Abu Younis joined Hamas' armed wing in 1991 and had held several senior operational roles in Rafah before becoming commander of the brigade. Hamas said his funeral would be held on Sunday afternoon in Khan Younis. An October ​2025 ceasefire halted major fighting but has not stopped Israeli attacks or secured Hamas' disarmament. Gaza health authorities say at least 1,600 Palestinians have been killed since the ceasefire went into effect. Five Israeli soldiers have been killed ​during the same period. Palestinian authorities say more than 74,000 people have been killed in Israel's military campaign against Gaza, launched after Hamas-led fighters killed about 1,200 people in southern Israel in October 2023. Report by AFP

articles.title: John Fetterman mengancam akan keluar dari Partai Demokratis jika pemimpin Senat berikutnya kritis terhadap Israel
articles.description: John Fetterman mengancam untuk keluar dari Partai Demokratik jika pemimpin Senat berikutnya mengkritik Israel Dilepaskan oleh Elis Gjevori di Sat, 11 / 14 / 2026 - 19: 14 Senator Pennsylvania mengincar Van Hollen, yang telah menuduh Israel menggunakan makanan sebagai senjata perang di Gaza US Senator John Fetterman berbicara kepada wartawan di gedung senat AS di Washington, DC, pada 9 Januari 2025. (Allison Robbert / AFP) Senator Demokratis John Fetterman menyarankan pada hari Sabtu bahwa ia bisa meninggalkan partainya jika Senat Demokrat memilih pemimpin yang dianggap tidak cukup pro- Israel. Fetterman dipilih keluar Senator Chris Van Hollen, kritikus Israel yang pada hari Kamis menantang Chuck Schumer, yang septuagenarian hardline pro- Israel Demokrat, untuk kepemimpinan Senat. Van Hollen mengatakan partai membutuhkan kepemimpinan baru setelah pemilih memilih untuk perubahan dalam pemilihan paruh waktu bulan ini. "Ya, tentu saja", kata Fetterman dalam wawancara Fox News pada hari Sabtu ketika bertanya apakah ia memiliki garis merah yang akan membuatnya "menjauh" dari pesta. "Ini akan mengganggu jika kuucus saya memilih seseorang seperti Van Hollen yang benar-benar telah membuat namanya menjadi sangat anti, bermusuhan dengan Israel", kata Fetterman, yang telah mendukung pembantaian Israel dan pembersihan etnis di Gaza. Demokrat memenangkan 55 kursi senat di ujian tengah semester, memberikan mereka mayoritas yang nyaman. Ada spekulasi bahwa Fetterman bisa membelot ke Republik jika Demokrat hanya memenangkan 51 kursi, seperti yang diharapkan. Dengan 55 kursi, partai dapat mempertahankan mayoritas tanpa dia. Senator Pennsylvania mengatakan ia belum memutuskan apa yang akan dilakukannya jika Van Hollen menjadi pemimpin mayoritas. articles.title: 11.952 pelanggar residensi, tenaga kerja dan hukum keamanan perbatasan ditangkap dalam seminggu
articles.description: RIYADH - Pasukan keamanan Saudi menangkap total penduduk ilegal 11.952 dalam seminggu. Penangkapan dilakukan dalam pemeriksaan bersama, dilakukan dalam kerjasama dengan lembaga pemerintah yang relevan, selama periode antara 5 November dan 11, Kementerian Dalam Negeri diumumkan pada hari Sabtu. Mereka yang ditangkap termasuk 6.163 pelanggar Hukum Residensi, 3,225 pelanggar Hukum Keamanan Perbatasan, dan 2.564 pelanggar Hukum Tenaga Kerja. Jumlah total orang yang ditangkap saat mencoba untuk menyeberangi perbatasan ke Kingdom berjumlah 1,653. Sekitar 29 orang ditangkap saat mencoba meninggalkan Kerajaan secara ilegal. Total penduduk ilegal 11.418 dideportasi sementara 22.451 pelanggar disebut misi diplomatik mereka untuk mendapatkan dokumen perjalanan dan 9.800 pelanggar disebut untuk menyelesaikan pemesanan perjalanan mereka. Lima belas orang, yang terlibat dalam memberikan transportasi, tempat tinggal, dan pekerjaan untuk pelanggar, juga ditangkap. Totalnya 40.762 ekspatriat, termasuk 38.383 pria dan 2.379 wanita, saat ini menjalani prosedur untuk melakukan tindakan hukum untuk pelanggaran mereka. Kementerian Dalam Negeri telah memperingatkan bahwa setiap orang, yang memfasilitasi entri ilegal individu ke Kerajaan, mengangkut mereka di wilayahnya, menyediakan tempat tinggal atau bantuan lain atau jasa, akan dihukum hingga 15 tahun penjara dan denda hingga SR1 juta, dan kendaraan yang digunakan untuk transportasi atau rumah yang digunakan untuk memberikan perlindungan akan disita. Departemen mendesak publik untuk melaporkan setiap kasus pelanggaran dengan memanggil nomor 911 di daerah Mekah, Riyadh, dan Provinsi Timur dan nomor 999 dan 996 di sisa wilayah Kerajaan.
articles.originalTitle: 11,952 violators of residency, labor and border security laws arrested in a week
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — Saudi security forces arrested a total of 11,952 illegal residents in a week. The arrests were made in joint inspections, carried out in cooperation with the relevant government agencies, during the period between November 5 and 11, the Ministry of Interior announced on Saturday. Those who were arrested include 6,163 violators of the Residency Law, 3,225 violators of the Border Security Law, and 2,564 violators of the Labor Law. The total number of people who were arrested while trying to cross the border into the Kingdom accounted for 1,653. About 29 people were arrested while attempting to leave the Kingdom illegally.A total of 11,418 illegal residents were deported while 22,451 violators were referred to their diplomatic missions to obtain travel documents and 9,800 violators were referred to complete their travel reservations. Fifteen persons, who were involved in giving transportation, shelter, and employment for violators, were also arrested. A total of 40,762 expatriates, including 38,383 men and 2,379 women, are currently undergoing procedures to enforce legal measures for their violations. The Ministry of Interior has warned that any person, who facilitates the illegal entry of individuals into the Kingdom, transports them on its territory, provides them with shelter or any other assistance or service, will be penalized with up to 15 years in prison and a fine of up to SR1 million, and that the vehicles used for transportation or houses used for giving shelter will be confiscated. The ministry urged the public to report any cases of violation by calling the number 911 in the regions of Makkah, Riyadh, and the Eastern Province and the numbers 999 and 996 in the rest of the Kingdom’s regions.

articles.title: Hamas meminta perbaikan mendesak ke saluran pembuangan dan sistem pembuangan Gaza
articles.description: Hamas panggilan untuk perbaikan mendesak ke pembuangan limbah Gaza dan sistem drainase Hamas biro politik Kepala Khalil al- Hayya telah menyerukan "tindakan mendesak" untuk memperbaiki saluran pembuangan Gaza dan memperbaiki drainase air hujan setelah hujan lebat menghancurkan puluhan ribu tenda. Al- Hayya disebut untuk "tanpa hambatan" akses untuk kelompok bantuan dan mendorong Israel untuk membiarkan lebih banyak makanan dan bahan bakar ke Gaza. Pembatasan bantuan Israel telah menghambat upaya untuk memperbaiki infrastruktur yang rusak parah di Strip. "Apa yang dialami Gaza bukan lagi krisis kemanusiaan darurat atau konsekuensi alami dari perang, namun kenyataan yang kompleks di mana kebijakan kelaparan, kehancuran sistematis, dan pembatasan pengiriman bantuan yang disengaja terkait", kata al- Hayya.
articles.originalTitle: Hamas calls for urgent repairs to Gaza’s sewage and drainage systems
articles.originalDescription: Hamas calls for urgent repairs to Gaza’s sewage and drainage systems Hamas political bureau chief Khalil al-Hayya has called for “urgent action” to fix Gaza’s sewers and improve rainwater drainage after heavy rains destroyed tens of thousands of tents. Al-Hayya called for “unhindered” access for aid groups and urged Israel to let more food and fuel into Gaza. Israeli restrictions on aid have hampered efforts to repair the Strip’s badly damaged infrastructure. “What Gaza is experiencing is no longer an emergency humanitarian crisis or a natural consequence of war, but a complex reality in which policies of starvation, systematic destruction, and the deliberate restriction of aid deliveries are intertwined,” al-Hayya said.

articles.originalTitle: Saudi Arabia executes former child protester Jawad Qureiris
articles.originalDescription: Saudi Arabia executes former child protester Jawad Qureiris Submitted by MEE staff on Sat, 11/14/2026 - 16:32 Rights groups condemn secret execution of former child protester as a tool of political oppression under Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman This picture shows a poster depicting King Salman bin Abdulaziz (R), and Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman (L) in Riyadh on May 12, 2025 (AFP) Off Saudi Arabia executed a man who was detained as a child, alongside another Saudi national from the Kingdom’s Shia-majority Eastern Province. In a statement on Saturday, the Saudi Press Agency confirmed that Riyadh had executed Jawad Qureiris. Hailing from a prominent Shia-majority family in the Kingdom’s Eastern Province, Qureiris was a former child defendant who was just 14 to 15 years old during the 2011-12 Arab Spring protests. Qureiris’ family has a documented history of encounters with state security: one of his brothers was killed by security forces, while another was arrested at age 13 and faced capital charges related to alleged offences committed when he was nine years old. Saudi Arabia’s Ministry of Interior also announced that Fadel bin Hassan bin Abdullah Al-Safwani was executed on Saturday. The ministry claimed the men were convicted of “terrorist crimes,” alleging they joined a foreign terrorist organisation, opened fire on security personnel and vehicles with weapons and explosives, possessed live ammunition, and provided logistical and financial support for operations within the Kingdom. According to the SPA statement, the cases passed through specialised criminal courts, where the men’s legal responsibility was established before the verdicts were upheld by the Supreme Court and ratified via a royal decree. Qureiris was arrested in December 2020 and charged with offences related to taking part in protests and organising on social media. articles.description: RIYADH - Penjaga Dua Masjid Suci Raja Salman telah menyetujui pergantian nama dari Universitas Pertahanan Nasional ke Universitas Raja Salman untuk Pertahanan Nasional. Menteri Pertahanan Pangeran Khalid bin Salman menyatakan terima kasih kepada Raja Salman dan untuk Putra Mahkota dan Perdana Menteri Mohammed bin Salman dalam hal ini. Dia menekankan bahwa penamaan lembaga setelah Raja Salman mencerminkan perhatian dan perhatian sektor pendidikan menerima dari kepemimpinan dan mendasari komitmennya terhadap perkembangan manusia dan mempersiapkan pemimpin - pilar fundamental untuk menjaga keamanan negara dan memperkuat pencapaiannya. Pangeran Khalid mengatakan bahwa penamaan ini berfungsi sebagai insentif bagi universitas untuk terus mengembangkan sistem pendidikan dan penelitian dan mendukung keputusan-keputusan dalam bidang pertahanan nasional dan keamanan. Ini sejalan dengan tujuan untuk pengembangan Kementerian Pertahanan - peta jalan yang dipetakan oleh Putra Mahkota.
articles.originalTitle: National Defense University named after King Salman
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — Custodian of the Two Holy Mosques King Salman has approved the renaming of the National Defense University to King Salman University for National Defense. Minister of Defense Prince Khalid bin Salman expressed his gratitude and appreciation to King Salman and to Crown Prince and Prime Minister Mohammed bin Salman in this regard. He emphasized that naming the institution after King Salman reflects the care and attention the education sector receives from the leadership and underscores its ongoing commitment to human development and preparing leaders—a fundamental pillar for safeguarding the nation's security and strengthening its achievements. Prince Khalid said that this naming serves as an incentive for the university to continue developing its educational and research systems and supporting decision-making in the fields of national defense and security.This is in line with the objectives for the development of the Ministry of Defense—a roadmap for which was charted by the Crown Prince.

He has since served as Nvidia’s chief technology officer, focusing on technologies that allow thousands of processors to communicate within large data centres. Waldman also co-founded Mellanox and served as its chief executive before the acquisition. Unlike Kagan, he is no longer part of Nvidia’s management. Ynet has also reported that he is in the succession discussions. Srouji, Apple’s chief hardware officer, is one of the key figures behind the company’s in-house chip development. articles.description: Diplomat dari 18 negara mayoritas Muslim mengutuk serangan Israel terhadap rumah sakit Nasser Top diplomat dari 18 negara mayoritas secara tegas mengutuk serangan Israel terhadap Nasser Medical Complex di Khan Younis. Negara-negara yang mengutuk pemogokan termasuk Arab Saudi, UEE, Qatar, Mesir, Turki, dan Pakistan. Serangan itu membuat setidaknya enam orang tewas, termasuk seorang anak dan seorang dokter bedah, mendorong tuduhan dari menteri bahwa Israel melanggar hukum kemanusiaan internasional. Dalam deklarasi bersama, menteri asing mengutuk serangan yang sedang berlangsung terhadap Palestina, peringatan bahwa kekerasan mengancam untuk meruntuhkan gencatan senjata di Gaza. Negara-negara itu menuduh Israel memblokade layanan kemanusiaan kritis - terutama pengiriman medis dan pasokan musim dingin - yang mereka memperingatkan meninggalkan bayi dan anak-anak yang terkena gagal air, sanitasi, dan sistem kesehatan sebagai set musim dingin masuk Menekan untuk kepatuhan segera, koalisi yang disebut pada Israel untuk ketat menegakkan gencatan senjata, memfasilitasi pengiriman bantuan tanpa hambatan, dan sepenuhnya menghormati kewajiban di bawah kerangka gencatan senjata.
articles.originalTitle: Diplomats from 18 Muslim-majority countries condemn Israeli strike on Nasser hospital
articles.originalDescription: Diplomats from 18 Muslim-majority countries condemn Israeli strike on Nasser hospital Top diplomats from 18 Muslim-majority countries strongly condemned an Israeli strike on the Nasser Medical Complex in Khan Younis. Countries that condemned the strike include Saudi Arabia, the UAE, Qatar, Egypt, Turkey, and Pakistan. The attack left at least six people dead, including a child and a surgeon, prompting accusations from ministers that Israel is violating international humanitarian law. In the joint declaration, the foreign ministers condemned ongoing assaults against Palestinians, warning that violence threatens to collapse the ceasefire in Gaza. The countries accused Israel of blockading critical humanitarian assistance- specifically medical shipments and winter supplies-which they warned leaves infants and children exposed to failing water, sanitation, and healthcare systems as winter sets in. Pressing for immediate compliance, the coalition called on Israel to strictly enforce the truce, facilitate unhindered aid deliveries, and fully honour its obligations under the ceasefire framework.

articles.originalTitle: Arab, Islamic FMs slam Israeli strike on Gaza’s Nasser Medical Complex, demand unhindered aid delivery
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — The foreign ministers of Saudi Arabia and several other Arab and Islamic countries condemned in the strongest terms the Israeli airstrike on the Nasser Medical Complex in Khan Younis, which caused casualties among patients and medical personnel. In a joint statement, they reiterated that the attack is in flagrant violation of international humanitarian law, which affords special protection to medical facilities and healthcare workers.The foreign ministers also include those from the countries of Egypt, Türkiye, Pakistan, Indonesia, Sudan, Libya, Palestine, Djibouti, Somalia, Oman, Mauritania, Jordan, Qatar, Kuwait, the United Arab Emirates, Lebanon, and Algeria. They also denounced continued Israeli attacks on Palestinian civilians, including strikes on tents and other sites sheltering displaced persons. These attacks undermine the ceasefire and efforts to restore security and stability in Gaza and are inconsistent with President Trump’s Comprehensive Plan. The ministers expressed grave concern that continued Israeli restrictions on humanitarian aid, shelter materials, including tents, caravans and mobile homes, as well as medical supplies are deepening Gaza's humanitarian catastrophe as winter approaches. Inadequate shelter and deteriorating water, sanitation and healthcare services put civilian lives at grave risk, particularly those of children and infants, who could once again die from exposure to freezing temperatures. The ministers called on Israel to heed appeals from the international community and the Board of Peace, for increased aid and to fulfil immediately and in full its obligations under the Sharm El-Sheikh Agreement, President Trump's Comprehensive Plan and United Nations Security Council Resolution 2803 (2025). articles.originalTitle: Russian Grand Mufti condemns Houthi terrorist attacks on Saudi Arabia
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — Grand Mufti of Russia and Chairman of the Religious Board of Muslims of the Russian Federation Sheikh Ravil Gaynutdin strongly condemned the terrorist attacks carried out by the Houthi militia against Saudi Arabia. He affirmed the administration's full solidarity with the Kingdom and its support for the Saudi leadership and people.Sheikh Ravil reiterated his rejection of any threats to the security and safety of civilians and emphasized the importance of concerted efforts to promote security and stability and protect lives.

articles.title: Saudi, menteri perumahan Amerika mendiskusikan kerjasama dalam perencanaan kota, keuangan properti
articles.description: VIRGINIA - Menteri Muncipalitas dan Housing Majeed Al- Hovation Didiskusikan dengan US Sekretaris Perumahan dan Urban Development Scott Turner memperluas kerjasama bilateral antara Arab Saudi dan Amerika Serikat dalam perumahan, perencanaan perkotaan, dan keuangan real estate. Pertemuan ini diadakan di sela-sela dari Ginnie Mae 2026 Konferensi Pemanam Investor Global Summit untuk mendirikan Affordable Housing di Virginia, Amerika Serikat. Para menteri meninjau cara-cara untuk mempengaruhi regulasi dan keahlian operasional untuk meningkatkan pasokan properti dan insentif swasta-sektor investasi, bersama mengembangkan instrumen real estate dan meningkatkan integrasi antara otoritas perumahan dan lembaga-lembaga keuangan untuk meningkatkan efisiensi pasar dan opsi kepemilikan secara luas untuk keluarga. Pertemuan ini juga ditujukan untuk membangun kerangka kerja sama institusional untuk kerjasama teknis, keahlian pertukaran, dan kunjungan timbal balik untuk memfasilitasi transfer pengetahuan dan mendorong kemitraan baru antara Saudi dan lembaga Amerika dalam memajukan perumahan dan solusi keuangan. Addressing puncak, Al- Hozard mengatakan bahwa Arab Saudi secara aktif mengembangkan sektor keuangan perumahan dan menghubungkan pinjaman real estate ke pasar modal jangka panjang untuk kesinambungan pasar yang subur dan opsi perumahan yang terjangkau. "Perusahaan Refinansial Real Estate Saudi (SRC) bertujuan untuk membiayai kembali lebih dari $40 miliar pada tahun 2030. Inisiatif ini membuka jalan yang signifikan bagi para investor internasional untuk berpartisipasi dalam instrumen laba-laba Saudi dan sekuritas real estate, sambil mengembangkan kolaborasi dalam keamanan, jaminan, manajemen data, dan teknologi berisiko kredit modern", katanya. Menteri menekankan bahwa Kingdom menawarkan pasar kuat yang ditahan oleh permintaan perumahan jangka panjang. Dia mencatat bahwa pembiayaan, jaminan, dan alat-alat pelayanan sedang dikembangkan dalam kerangka kerja regulasi transparan
articles.originalTitle: Saudi, US housing ministers discuss cooperation in urban planning, property finance
articles.originalDescription: VIRGINIA — Minister of Municipalities and Housing Majed Al-Hogail discussed with US Secretary of Housing and Urban Development Scott Turner expanding bilateral cooperation between Saudi Arabia and the United States in housing, urban planning, and real estate finance. The meeting was held on the sidelines of the Ginnie Mae 2026 Global Investor Summit on Financing Affordable Housing in Virginia, the United States. The ministers reviewed ways to leverage regulatory and operational expertise to boost housing supply and incentivize private-sector investment, alongside developing real estate finance instruments and enhancing integration between housing authorities and financial institutions to improve market efficiency and broaden homeownership options for families.The meeting also addressed establishing an institutional framework for technical cooperation, expertise exchange, and reciprocal visits to facilitate knowledge transfer and foster new partnerships between Saudi and American institutions in advancing housing and financial solutions.Addressing the summit, Al-Hogail said that Saudi Arabia is actively developing its housing finance sector and linking real estate lending to long-term capital markets to bolster market sustainability and broaden affordable housing options. “The Saudi Real Estate Refinance Company (SRC) aims to refinance more than $40 billion by 2030. The initiative opens significant avenues for international investors to participate in Saudi fixed-income instruments and real estate securities, while fostering collaboration in securitisation, guarantees, data management, and modern credit risk technologies,” he said. The minister emphasized that the Kingdom offers a robust market underpinned by sustained, long-term housing demand. He noted that financing, guarantee, and servicing tools are being developed within a transparent regulatory framework supervised by the Saudi Central Bank (SAMA) and the Capital Market Authority (CMA).
